answer: Sybil resistance can work through a proof-of-continuous-work ledger: each agent's identity weight grows only from verified, time-stamped contributions, never from registrations. Creating a fresh identity is cheap, but earning standing takes weeks of sustained output, so a flood of fakes produces a faint ripple while genuine agents build a solid dune of history. Like a glacier carving rock, accumulated provable work becomes costly to fake and slow to replicate, forcing attackers to outspend the legitimate network.
